library.description: Native Redis and Valkey storage backend

blocks.text: English
把 Redis 或 Valkey 接到统一存储接口，集中处理组织键、过期时间、记录查询和显式键锁，减少业务代码逐次拼接物理键和补写期限的负担。选择已连接客户端对应的驱动并安装插件后，可按需增加 Streams、限流或向量检索；可用能力取决于服务模块与驱动，Redis 的事务部分失败限制仍然适用。

更新活值后过期时间消失：写值与设置 TTL 分成了不同操作。
MULTI 返回了错误，却已有数据写入：EXEC 逐项错误不等于回滚。
服务重连后漏了变化：把 Pub/Sub 当成了历史队列。
统一处理逻辑键和组织。 标准方法为文本、字节、记录生成不同物理键，同名组织数据隔离，见带期限的组织数据。
把标准修改放进一次 EXEC。 值、索引、修订和通知一起提交，并在发送前检查可识别的输入错误；仍如实保留 Redis 部分失败限制，见事务与并发限制。
通知与可重放历史各有入口。 Pub/Sub 适合在线提示，Stream 变更历史适合从游标继续，见从变更历史继续。
选择服务真正提供的模块。 向量 Feature 检测 Search 模块和驱动二进制端口，缺少就拒绝，不以本地计算冒充原生检索。这里不作性能比较。

普通覆盖保留活值 TTL，expire(0) 立即删除，期限与锁使用 Redis TIME/PTTL。小数毫秒向上取整；超出安全整数的绝对期限在 EXEC 前拒绝。getMany 保留输入顺序、重复与缺失位置；批量写拒绝规范等价重复键，空批零命令。标准 KV、记录、TTL、counter 都可在 tx 中使用；字节和文本、记录分别保存。

组织共用带 hash tag 的物理命名空间，相关键同槽；同名逻辑键、期限、修订和锁隔离。prefix 默认 migaia，maxLockMs 默认30000；concurrency 选择冲突策略。dropOrg 删除该组织标准数据及既有 Streams、sorted-set、限流和向量点，即使重启后没再选择对应 Feature；保留其它组织、调用方非托管键和共享检索 schema。clearAll 仍只清标准通道。
事务读取不会自动加逻辑锁；显式 lock 才创建 SET NX PX 锁。普通写沿所选并发策略处理。WATCH 在依赖读取前建立，数据、索引、修订和通知进入同一 EXEC。回调在 EXEC 前失败时不写入；EXEC 返回 null 才是已确认的 WATCH 放弃，可按冲突策略重试。
EXEC 逐项失败可能部分提交，发送后断连可能结果未知。这两者都不自动重放，并封闭这次安装的新写入；读取和释放仍可用。不能把 transactions:true 理解成原生错误后完整回滚。不要把外部副作用放进可能重试的回调。
下面显式安装四个 Feature，实际写入 Stream、榜单与限流键，并发送一条消息。新命名空间首次运行通常输出 true、Ada、true、3；重复运行时已有队列内容或未到期配额可改变前几项结果。

blocks.text: 这些原生 API 出现在 store.api，不在 tx.api。Streams 与 PubSub 各有自己的消息语义，不会自动成为标准提交日志。订阅需要专用真实连接；先释放订阅，再释放 host 和 SDK。Keyspace 过滤命名空间与组织，但不会替你开启服务器通知配置。
Streams group 阻塞读取使用专用连接，每次原生 BLOCK 最多1000ms；只有空结果才继续等待，原生错误直接拒绝。取消或关闭要等当前阻塞片结束。PubSub 回调拒绝只报告，不能撤回已提交的发布。
显式选择 change-stream，让标准写入与历史 XADD 进入同一 EXEC。示例从当前高水位开始，等待一次标准提交，打印服务给出的 cursor；其值由服务决定。

每次提交同时追加到两条 Stream：共享的一条和本组织自己的一条。根 store 读共享 Stream，能看到所有组织；组织 store 只读自己的 Stream，所以一个写得很多的组织不会把安静组织的历史挤出保留窗口，也不会让它的读取扫过别的组织的条目。游标只属于返回它的那个 store 所读的 Stream，不要把根 store 的游标交给组织 store，反过来也一样。dropOrg 保留该组织的变更历史。maxLen 必须是正安全整数，对每条 Stream 分别生效，使用原生近似 MAXLEN 裁剪。readChanges({after,limit}) 默认limit100，从排他游标读起。处理效果和检查点应在回调成功前完成；tail 只在 onChange 成功后推进，失败报告并关闭，不越过失败项。游标是原生 Stream ID，按原样保存，不转成不精确的 JS number。
非初始游标落后于保留首项时报 CHANGE_CURSOR_EXPIRED。0-0 也不是“忽略丢失历史”：只有 XINFO 证明从未移除记录时可继续，裁剪后同样拒绝。跨裁剪边界保守拒绝。这份历史只覆盖标准库提交，不承诺外部原生命令或纯自然过期事件；普通 best-effort 变更提示也不能代替它。

sections.heading: 使用 Search 向量检索

blocks.text: 需要真实 Search 模块和二进制 connection/EXEC 端口。部分 Redis 8部署包含 Search，缺模块的 Valkey 会拒绝该 Feature。Bun 内置驱动缺少二进制端口，不能使用此例；基础 KV 不受影响。预期输出 guide。
新集合给 dimensions/metric，随后连接通过 FT.INFO 读取实际配置。默认近邻索引用HNSW，exact:true用FLAT；相同FLOAT32字节进入两组字段。cosine/dot分数为1-distance，euclid为-sqrt(distance)。FLOAT32溢出、转换后为零的cosine方向在修改前拒绝。
组织TAG、期限NUMERIC在KNN排名中过滤；可忠实表达的scalar条件下推，其它条件或函数仅过滤引擎命中，不补搜。requirePushdown在I/O前拒绝客户端条件，minScore是有界客户端阈值。payload保留完整便携编码，scalar索引字段按需通过FT.ALTER增加。相似/推荐查询读取指定样本后生成方向，不保证其它候选被补搜。

Search 的TAG token上限4096字节。超过上限的规范等值/成员条件不承诺下推；普通where仍可过滤topK命中，requirePushdown报QUERY_NOT_PUSHABLE；deleteWhere与原生search.filter在I/O前报UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY。完整payload、ID与物理键不截断。样本排除使用SHA-256短TAG，不承诺数学上零碰撞。

vector TTL使用同一WATCH/EXEC：TIME生成绝对期限，HASH字段与PEXPIREAT一起写，普通upsert保期限，persist同时清期限字段和原生expiry。根与真实事务TTL都接受vector target，但向量集合不因此获得通用事务能力。deleteWhere默认precount，两种count模式都分页找点后实际删除，只返回存在并提交删除的数量；原生已过期HASH不计数。
宿主默认自动检测。设置 autoDetect:false 时，使用所选后端能力前先 await host.detect()。版本满足不等于安装了 Search 模块。

nodeRedisDriver接受node-redis 6的pool；ioredisDriver接受ioredis 6 client；bunRedisDriver接受Bun RedisClient，分别从/node-redis、/ioredis、/bun导入。它们借用已连接客户端，不关闭原对象。ioredis内部连接禁用未确认命令重发；node-redis保留同一pool租约和EXEC逐项错误；Bun在MULTI前拒绝二进制输入。根入口不加载SDK，每个订阅消耗独立连接。
标准记录字段查询在客户端执行，不提供标准secondaryIndexes、SQL或RDF。文本/字节缺失为null，记录为undefined。物理索引可能残留已过期条目，读取会核对真实键；前缀删除使用有序索引，inspectLocks和部分清理需SCAN，成本包含实际扫描候选。

本包错误source为storage.backend.redis，REDIS_FAILED表示原生命令/连接/EXEC故障，TRANSACTION_FAILED表示未分类的业务回调/草稿失败，DECODE_FAILED表示协议或持久化数据不能解码。共享契约、host和本包已有错误保留身份，原始错误沿cause可达。dispose重复返回同一主Promise，符号释放用另一个报告型Promise，只清理自有订阅和租约。
host journal可以选择提交后外置binlog和遥测。只有EXEC全部成功才追加成功提交日志；原生部分错误或未知结果不追加、不重放。binlog失败经report报告，不能撤回已提交数据，外置日志与业务数据并非强原子提交。标准值、字节、记录与向量的镜像保留实际wire和绝对期限；历史向量完整before镜像需要二进制端口，缺少时此日志组合在修改前拒绝。

此后端明确nativeAtomic:false。要求同EXEC强原子binlog、WAL intent/marker或undo的组合当前拒绝，不得当作已支持能力。storageLogStore单独从`@migaia/storage-host/plugins/journal`导入，每次在原生命名空间读当前索引；多个实例可共用namespace和连续序号，不跨操作缓存索引。原生Feature API不冒充标准业务通道的日志来源。遥测显式启用，根操作和完整事务跨重试各记一次；logger及载体仍由调用方在host之后释放。
中文

Use Redis or Valkey through one storage API that handles organization keys, expiry, record queries and explicit key locks, reducing repeated key-prefix and expiry code. Choose a driver for your connected client or pool, install the plugin, and add Streams, rate limiting or vector search when needed. Available capabilities depend on the server modules and driver; Redis transaction partial-failure limits still apply.

Keep logical keys and organizations consistent. Text, bytes and records use separate physical keys while equal keys in different organizations remain isolated. See Organization data with expiry.

Submit standard mutations in one EXEC. Values, indexes, revisions and notifications share the commit, with identifiable input failures checked first. Redis's partial-failure limits still apply. See Transactions and concurrency.
Choose live hints or retained history deliberately. Pub/Sub serves online listeners; the change Stream can resume from a cursor. See Resume change history.

Use capabilities the server actually has. Vector selection checks the Search module and binary driver ports instead of silently replacing native search with local computation. No performance comparison is claimed.

blocks.text: The root entry loads no SDK. ioredis and node-redis provide binary commands/EXEC. The Bun adapter has no binary port: basic KV remains available, but Search vectors cannot be selected. Each subscription needs its own connection; leave pool capacity for both subscriptions and business operations. Exact peer ranges are in module.json.

Prefix defaults to migaia and maxLockMs to 30000. Ordinary overwrites retain TTL; deadlines and locks use Redis time. Standard record queries evaluate on the client. Standard secondary indexes, SQL and RDF are absent. Organization views use the same namespace mapping; dropOrg also removes that organization's supported persistent Feature data.

Ordinary change hints are best effort, without external-command coverage, reconnect replay or instant expiry notification. Search requires the real module; connecting to Valkey does not imply vector support. EXEC item failures and disconnects after send can leave partial or unknown writes. 中文

These complete programs need Redis 7.2+ or Valkey 7.2.5+ and REDIS_URL. Set REDIS_SEARCH_URL for the vector example to a service that actually provides Search. Programs write data. Release the host before closing its caller-created pool.

rows: Sessions, expiry, counters and tenant isolation
Application queues, messages, rankings or quotas

blocks.text: Expected output: active, then 1. The explicit lock protects a logical key; organization IDs are UUIDs.

Overwriting a live value retains TTL; expire(0) deletes immediately. Expiry and locks use Redis TIME/PTTL. Fractional milliseconds round up; unsafe absolute deadlines reject before EXEC. getMany retains order, duplicates and missing positions. Batch writes reject equivalent duplicate keys; empty batches issue no commands. Standard KV, records, TTL and counters also work on tx. Text, bytes and records use separate channels.

Organizations share a hash-tagged physical namespace so related keys stay in one cluster slot. Keys, expiry, revisions and locks remain organization-specific. Prefix defaults to migaia, maxLockMs to 30000; concurrency selects a conflict policy. dropOrg removes the organization's standard data plus existing Streams, sorted-set, quota and vector points, even if a later installation no longer selects those Features. It retains other organizations, unmanaged application keys and shared Search schemas. clearAll keeps its standard-channel scope.

Transaction reads do not automatically lock keys. Explicit lock uses SET NX PX; ordinary writes use the selected concurrency policy. WATCH starts before dependent reads. Values, indexes, revisions and notifications enter one EXEC. A callback failure before EXEC writes nothing. Only a native null EXEC proves a WATCH abort and can enter ordinary conflict retry handling.

An EXEC item error may leave partial writes. A disconnect after sending EXEC may leave an unknown result. Neither is automatically replayed; new writes for that installation are sealed while reads and disposal remain available. transactions:true is not a promise of complete rollback after native execution errors. Keep external effects outside callbacks that may retry.

The program selects four Features and writes a Stream entry, ranking, quota and message. In a fresh namespace, typical output is true, Ada, true,3. Existing entries and an unexpired quota can affect later runs.

rows: add/range/createGroup/readGroup/ack/autoClaim; range-/+ and count 100; group 0-0 with createStream:true; read count 100, nonblocking when block is omitted
publish/subscribe/keyspace; binary messages use canonical base64 text; keyspace supports expired/del/set and returns actual physical-key UTF-8 bytes
add/rank/top; finite scores, ascending top 10, UTF-16 logical-member order for ties, no command for empty add
positive safe limit/windowMs, consume cost 1 by default; rejection does not increase the count, resetAfterMs comes from PTTL

blocks.text: These APIs appear on store.api, not tx.api. Application Streams and Pub/Sub retain their own delivery semantics and do not automatically become standard commit logs. Subscriptions need dedicated real connections. Release the subscription, then the host, then the SDK. Keyspace notifications filter the namespace/organization without changing server notification configuration.

Blocking group reads hold a dedicated connection. Each native BLOCK is at most 1000 ms; only empty replies continue waiting. Native failures reject immediately. Cancellation and disposal drain the current blocking slice. Pub/Sub callback rejection only reports and cannot undo a committed publication.
Select change-stream so standard writes and history XADD share one EXEC. This starts at the actual high-water position, waits for a standard commit and prints its server-assigned cursor.

Each commit is appended to two Streams: the shared one and its organization's own. The root store reads the shared Stream and sees every organization; an organization store reads only its own Stream, so a busy organization cannot push a quiet organization's history out of retention or make its reads scan foreign entries. A cursor belongs to the Stream of the store that returned it; do not pass a root cursor to an organization store or the reverse. dropOrg keeps the organization's change history. maxLen is a positive safe integer, applies to each Stream separately and uses native approximate MAXLEN trimming. readChanges({after,limit}) defaults to 100 and reads after the exclusive cursor. Finish derived effects and checkpoint persistence before a tail callback succeeds. Tail advances only after onChange succeeds; rejection reports and closes without skipping the failed item. Cursors are native Stream IDs; preserve strings rather than converting them into imprecise numbers.

A noninitial cursor behind retained history raises CHANGE_CURSOR_EXPIRED. 0-0 does not bypass lost history: it resumes only when XINFO proves nothing has been removed, and rejects after trimming. Crossing a trim boundary also rejects conservatively. This history covers standard library commits, not external native commands or immediate natural-expiry events. Ordinary best-effort change hints cannot replace it.

The service needs the actual Search module and the driver needs binary connection/EXEC ports. Some Redis 8 deployments include Search; a Valkey deployment without the module rejects this Feature. Bun's adapter lacks those binary ports, so it cannot run this example, while its basic KV remains available. Expected output: guide.

New collections specify dimensions and metric; later connections read the real schema through FT.INFO. Approximate search uses HNSW; exact:true uses FLAT. Both fields receive identical FLOAT32 bytes. Cosine/dot score is 1-distance; Euclidean score is -sqrt(distance). FLOAT32 overflow and cosine directions that become zero after conversion reject before modification.

Organization TAG and expiry NUMERIC filters apply inside native KNN ranking. Faithful scalar conditions push down; other conditions and functions filter engine hits without refill. requirePushdown rejects client conditions before I/O; minScore is a bounded client threshold. Full payloads retain portable encoding while scalar index fields are added with FT.ALTER. Similar/recommend reads the specified samples, constructs a direction and uses the same native query without promising extra candidates.

Search TAG tokens are limited to 4096 bytes. Longer canonical equality/member conditions are not declared pushable. Ordinary where can still filter topK hits; requirePushdown raises QUERY_NOT_PUSHABLE, and deleteWhere/native search.filter raise UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY before I/O. Full payloads, IDs and physical keys are not truncated. Sample exclusion uses SHA-256 short TAGs without promising mathematically collision-free identity.

Vector TTL uses the same WATCH/EXEC path: Redis TIME supplies an absolute deadline, HASH metadata and PEXPIREAT change together, ordinary upsert retains expiry, and persist clears both deadline fields and native expiry. Root and real transaction TTL accept vector targets; collections do not gain general transaction support. deleteWhere defaults to precount. Both count modes page through actual points before deletion and return only existing committed deletions. Already expired native HASHes do not count.
Host detection runs automatically by default. With autoDetect:false, await host.detect() before using the selected backend capabilities. A version check does not imply a Search module is installed.

nodeRedisDriver accepts a node-redis 6 pool; ioredisDriver accepts an ioredis 6 client; bunRedisDriver accepts Bun RedisClient. Import them from /node-redis, /ioredis and /bun. Inject connected clients; the adapters never close the supplied root object. Owned ioredis connections disable replay of unacknowledged commands. node-redis retains one pool lease and per-item EXEC errors. Bun rejects binary input before MULTI. The root entry loads no SDK; reserve one connection per subscription.

Standard record field queries run on the client. Standard secondary indexes, SQL and RDF are absent. Missing text/bytes return null; missing records return undefined. Native indexes can retain expired entries and reads check actual keys. Prefix deletion uses an ordered index; lock inspection and some clearing use SCAN, whose cost includes real candidates visited.

module failures use source storage.backend.redis: REDIS_FAILED for commands/connections/EXEC, TRANSACTION_FAILED for uncategorized business callback/draft failures, DECODE_FAILED for malformed replies or stored data. Existing shared, host and Redis errors retain identity and the original error remains reachable through cause. Repeated dispose returns one main Promise; symbolic release has a separate report-only Promise. Cleanup releases only subscriptions and leases the adapter created.

Host journal configuration supports post-commit external binlog and telemetry. A success log is appended only after every EXEC item succeeds; partial or unknown outcomes do not append success or replay. Binlog failure reports but cannot roll back committed data: external append is not atomic with business writes. Standard values, bytes, records and vector images retain actual wire values and absolute expiry. Complete before images for historical vector deletion require binary ports; without them that logging combination rejects before modification.

nodeRedisDriver接受node-redis 6的pool；ioredisDriver接受ioredis 6 client；bunRedisDriver接受Bun RedisClient，分别从/node-redis、/ioredis、/bun导入。它们借用已连接客户端，不关闭原对象。ioredis内部连接禁用未确认命令重发；node-redis保留同一pool租约和EXEC逐项错误；Bun在MULTI前拒绝二进制输入。根入口不加载SDK，每个订阅消耗独立连接。
标准记录字段查询在客户端执行，不提供标准secondaryIndexes、SQL或RDF。文本/字节缺失为null，记录为undefined。物理索引可能残留已过期条目，读取会核对真实键；前缀删除使用有序索引，inspectLocks和部分清理需SCAN，成本包含实际扫描候选。

本包错误source为storage.backend.redis，REDIS_FAILED表示原生命令/连接/EXEC故障，TRANSACTION_FAILED表示未分类的业务回调/草稿失败，DECODE_FAILED表示协议或持久化数据不能解码。共享契约、host和本包已有错误保留身份，原始错误沿cause可达。dispose重复返回同一主Promise，符号释放用另一个报告型Promise，只清理自有订阅和租约。
